messages:
simon: Hey team — heads up, I have a direct report moving from IC -> Senior IC with a band change and a relocation to the UK. Need to confirm what we need to file for comp, retro, and payroll flags. Payroll cutoff is Tue EOD so want to know if this is even feasible this cycle.

maya: @simon thanks for the heads up. Quick checklist: manager justification, updated role profile, new base salary + effective date, approved comp change signoff, org chart snippet, and calculated retro amount (if any). Please open the promotions intake form so we can track. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/promotions-intake

simon: Do we need any country-specific payroll flags for the UK? Also, will equity/grant timing be affected?

jess: For the UK specifically: set tax_jurisdiction = UK on the HRIS ticket, and attach the employee's local tax forms (if they have a P45 from prior employer include it). We typically do NOT gross-up offers except in rare recruiting exceptional cases — please flag if you think this is one. Equity: stock-admin must approve any grant/refresh; we can request a grant at the new band but vest schedule changes are exceptional and slow.

oliver-bot: payroll cutoff reminder: Next payroll bundle closes in 36 hours (1776630000). Any comps submitted after cutoff will be processed in the following run.

maya: If you want retro in this cycle we need the fully completed intake + manager sign-off + finance approval before cutoff. For evidence, acceptable items are short bullets — not a novel doc. Example evidence block you can paste into the form:

```
- Performance summary (2-3 bullets) showing stretch impact
- New responsibilities mapped to band rubric
- Market comp check attached (1-pager)
- Manager approval: simon@redwood.com
```

maya: Also include proposed effective date (usually first of month unless local payroll constraints), and preferred retro calc (start date -> eff date). We'll run the retro calc and confirm amount.

simon: If they start UK payroll mid-month, any immediate tax implications? Will we need to backdate for local statutory entitlements?

jess: Mid-month joiners can have withholding differences — UK payroll will prorate gross but taxes are operated on cumulative basis; Payroll will handle tax coding but we need correct join date and NI status. For statutory entitlements (holiday accrual), those follow local rules but comp changes don’t typically change statutory accruals retroactively. If you need a gross-up or special handling, mark as "escalate-to-comp" in the ticket.

simon: Got it. For equity, how long does stock-admin usually take? We might need grant paperwork for the new role before notifying the hire.

jess: Stock-admin SLA is ~10 business days once they receive a fully completed grant request + approvals. If you need faster, include a business justification in the ticket and cc stock-admin.

maya: Next steps from you: 1) open intake form + attach the evidence bullets, 2) add "tax_jurisdiction: UK" and attach any paperwork, 3) set desired effective date and retro preference, 4) cc finance if >10% comp change. I’ll triage as soon as the form lands.

simon: Thanks — I'll file now and ping if cutoff looks tight. :thumbsup:

maya: Sounds good — ping me in-thread if it’s urgent and I’ll prioritize. :sparkles:
